title: Function Health comparison table
description: A serif heading (italic first half) over a two-column comparison: a cream rounded table with hairline rows, and the brand's column picked out as a tall terracotta-to-sand gradient pillar that rises above the table and hangs below it, holding the brand mark, bold figures and white check discs. The competing column shows a bold figure then outlined crosses.
notes: a row value is a string (shown bold), true (check) or false (cross)
the pillar assumes a dark-enough primary: its text uses the page colour
name: functionhealth-compare

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark shown at the top of the terracotta pillar

props.description: header over the other column, e.g. "Standard checkup"
